description: Wallet Tasks 9-10: Opaque test payment references (CounterTestAuthorization binding to wallet with step-up for changes, no balance/credential fields) and typed Wallet/Merchant runtime clients (generated from merchant-contracts with manifest verification, error normalization)
steps: Task 9 - CounterTestAuthorization in packages/wallet-domain/src/payment-references.ts: Define PaymentAuthorizationReference interface (opaque, wallet-bound, principal-bound, environment-scoped, validity window). Define CounterTestAuthorization extending it with explicit test_only environment marker and bounds (amount ceiling, currency, eligible merchants, eligible operations). Reference is opaque - no balance/top-up/raw credential fields in schemas.

Task 9 - Payment reference service in packages/wallet-application/src/payment-reference-service.ts: Implement create/update/revoke for payment references. Changing a reference requires principal step-up. On change, reevaluate all affected mandates and invalidate/revoke those that no longer satisfy the reference constraint.

Task 9 - Schema enforcement: Verify that PaymentAuthorizationReference and CounterTestAuthorization types have NO fields for: balance, top_up, raw_credential, pan, cvv, upi_pin, bank_credential, provider_secret, token. Add a compile-time/test-time check that these fields do not exist.

Task 9 - Test payment reference tests: Test that test references are rejected by any live adapter check (environment mismatch), no balance/secret fields exist in the type, step-up required for reference changes, affected mandates are invalidated on reference change, reference binding to wallet/principal/agent/merchant/operation is enforced.

Task 10 - Merchant runtime client types in packages/wallet-contracts/src/merchant-client-types.ts: Define typed client interfaces for: CapabilityClient (verify signed merchant manifest, check environment/domain/India metadata, operation health), SearchClient (product search with source freshness), QuoteClient (get quote, verify digest/freshness/signature), TransactionClient (create transaction, check version, poll status), ActionClient (list pending actions, get action details), ReceiptClient (fetch receipt, verify signature/audience/chain).

Task 10 - Merchant runtime client implementation in packages/wallet-application/src/merchant-runtime-client.ts: Implement MerchantRuntimeClient that consumes contracts from @counter/merchant-contracts. Verify signed merchant manifest before any operation. Check environment/domain match, India metadata (legal/settlement country), operation health. Normalize errors to safe structured types. Preserve Indeterminate/review/action-required states without collapsing them.

Task 10 - Manifest verification: Verify merchant capability manifest signature, check that manifest environment matches wallet environment, verify domain ownership claims, confirm India geography metadata, check operation health/availability status.

Task 10 - Error normalization in packages/wallet-application/src/client-errors.ts: Define structured error types for client operations: NetworkError, TimeoutError, MalformedResponseError, ManifestVerificationError, StaleManifestError, UnknownExtensionError, ServerError. Map all errors to safe representations (no internal details leaked).

Task 10 - Runtime client tests: Test malicious/malformed responses handled gracefully, downgrade attempts rejected (e.g., weaker signature), stale manifest detection (expired/superseded), unknown extension fields handled safely, network timeout produces Indeterminate (not failure), manifest verification failure blocks all operations, quote digest verification catches tampering.
Run all verification commands to confirm everything passes.
acceptance_criteria: CounterTestAuthorization has explicit test_only marker and no balance/credential fields
Payment reference changes require step-up and trigger mandate reevaluation
Test references are environment-bound and rejected outside test contexts
Typed merchant runtime client consumes merchant-contracts with full type safety
Manifest verification checks signature, environment, domain, India metadata, and health
Errors normalized to safe structured types preserving Indeterminate state
Malformed/malicious responses and stale manifests handled gracefully
All builds, tests, lint, and depcruise pass
